records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended December 31, 2023, consolidated revenue was $8.4 billion, a decrease of $70.0 million or 0.8%, as compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Bookings decreased 4.4% over the prior year to $8.0 billion for the year ended December 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in inventories is due to reduced purchasing of inventories as supply chains have normalized.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Pricing and productivity initiatives continued during the year to offset the impact of lower volumes across some of the Company's businesses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash flow from operating activities for the year ended December 31, 2023 increased by $530.6 million compared to 2022.
